evidence_text: paired endocardial tubes fuse to a single heart tube at CS9 (~20 dpo)
looping is complete and chamber identity established by CS11-12; the tube is no longer present as such
upper limb bud appears at CS12 (~26 dpo)
digital rays separate and the bud is no longer a bud by CS18
lower limb bud appears at CS13, one stage after the forelimb
foot plate and digital rays by CS19
lateral and medial ganglionic eminences are distinguishable from CS15
the eminences regress during the fetal period; the exact stage needs a source
paired cerebellar plates form from the rhombic lip at CS16
rhombic lip is present from CS14
optic vesicles evaginate from the forebrain at CS11
the vesicle invaginates to form the optic cup at CS13
optic cup forms by invagination of the optic vesicle at CS13
respiratory diverticulum evaginates from the foregut at CS12 (~4 weeks)
third pharyngeal pouch endoderm forms the thymic primordium at CS13-14
ureteric bud contacts metanephric mesenchyme at CS14 (~5 weeks)
gonadal ridge thickens on the mesonephros at CS15
bipotential gonad present from CS15
gonadal sex differentiation is underway by CS20; the gonad is no longer indifferent
cartilaginous skull base is established at CS16; ossification begins later
neural folds begin to fuse at CS10; posterior neuropore closes at CS12
sclerotomes form progressively in a rostrocaudal sequence as somites differentiate; no single onset stage
the arch arteries appear and remodel in sequence across CS12-CS20
vertebral elements chondrify in a rostrocaudal sequence; serial, not a point onset
